title: Shortest window containing all required characters
summary: Walking down a market street, find the shortest run of stalls that sells everything on your list.
goal: Find the shortest stretch of stalls that covers the whole shopping list

examples.label: ADOBECODEBANC / ABC
examples.explanation: BANC is the shortest stretch with an A, a B and a C.

examples.label: One stall
examples.explanation: The single stall covers the list.

examples.label: Not enough
examples.explanation: The list needs two a's; the street has one, so no window works.

ladder.name: Check every window
ladder.idea: For every start and end, count the stalls in the window and check they cover the list.

ladder.name: Extend from each start
ladder.idea: For each start, walk right keeping counts until the list is covered; that is the shortest window from that start.
ladder.insight: Once a window from a fixed start covers the list, longer windows from that start cannot be shorter, so stop extending.

ladder.name: Grow, then shrink
ladder.idea: Grow the window to the right until the list is covered, then shrink it from the left while it stays covered, recording the shortest. Repeat.
ladder.insight: When the left edge moves right, the shortest cover from the new start never needs a right edge further left than before, so neither edge ever moves back.

transfer.problem: In a long security log, find the shortest stretch of entries that includes every one of five suspicious IP addresses.
transfer.explanation: It is a shortest window covering a required set: grow until everything is present, then shrink from the left.

selfCheck: Counts repeated list items, such as two a's.
Shrinks from the left while the window still covers the list.
Records the window before shrinking past coverage.
Returns an empty string when no window works.
